TabTab 2.1.3 – Speed and Stability

  • Made the switcher faster to present and hide when activating apps. Apps are also brought to the front more quickly
  • Improved tab tracking and cleanup so closed, stale, and newly opened tabs stay in sync more reliably
  • Expanded tab tracking across Chrome and Microsoft Edge Dev, Beta, and Canary channels, with Firefox Developer Edition support too
  • Fixed occasionally missing Safari tabs
  • Improved favicon loading and fixed additional app and tab icon issues
  • More polish and stability improvements

Thanks for using TabTab! ❤️

TabTab 2.1.2 - Faster and more reliable

  • Made switching to browser tabs much faster, even while TabTab is refreshing in the background
  • Made tab lists and search more responsive
  • Fixed stale browser tabs lingering after a window was closed or a browser was quit
  • Improved reliability when switching to or closing browser tabs and windows

Thanks for using TabTab! ❤️
